tier1.text: A vertebra bears weight and protects the spinal cord. Each vertebra is one bone of the vertebral column, or spine, in the neck and back. The spinal cord runs down the back through an opening in each vertebra. Neighboring vertebrae are joined by intervertebral discs, pads that let the spine move.

sentences.text: A vertebra bears weight and protects the spinal cord.

quotes.quote: A typical vertebra consists of an anterior body and a posterior vertebral arch. The body serves for weight bearing. The vertebral arch surrounds and protects the spinal cord.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: Each vertebra is one bone of the vertebral column, or spine, in the neck and back.

quotes.quote: vertebra: individual bone in the neck and back regions of the vertebral column
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: The vertebral column is also known as the spinal column or spine
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The spinal cord runs down the back through an opening in each vertebra.

quotes.quote: It also protects the spinal cord, which passes down the back through openings in the vertebrae.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: Neighboring vertebrae are joined by intervertebral discs, pads that let the spine move.

quotes.quote: intervertebral disc: structure located between the bodies of adjacent vertebrae that strongly joins the vertebrae; provides padding, weight bearing ability, and enables vertebral column movements
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
